name: Go Nuts for Donuts: Premium Picks
summary: Four players secretly split 6 premium picks between Glazed and Jelly, then for 10 rounds talk and simultaneously pick one of five donuts; a donut scores only for a lone chooser.

player.meaning: Glazed picks remaining (G at start); never told to others
Jelly picks remaining (6 - G at start); never told to others
non-void Glazed choices made so far (announced each round)
non-void Jelly choices made so far (announced each round)
this round's donut choice, secret until the reveal
this round's choice was VOID (Glazed with 0 glazed_picks or Jelly with 0 jelly_picks)

setup: Every player starts with score 0, donuts 0, glazed_used 0 and jelly_used 0.
All players are polled at once, privately, for a whole number G from 0 to 6.
Each player's glazed_picks is set to G and jelly_picks to 6 - G. Only the owner sees these values, and nobody else is ever told G.

round.effect: Announce the round number and, for every seat, score, donuts, glazed_used and jelly_used. Remaining picks are not announced.
Every message is broadcast to all once all are in: 'Seat {seat} says: {value}'. Messages are not binding.

round.answer: one of: Glazed, Jelly, Cruller, Sprinkle, Plain

round.effect: void = (choice == 'Glazed' and glazed_picks == 0) or (choice == 'Jelly' and jelly_picks == 0); gain = 0
Reveal every seat's choice together, with VOID shown for each seat whose void is true.

For each donut D, let n_D = the number of seats with choice == D and void == false. A seat with void == false whose choice D has n_D == 1 gets gain = value of D (Glazed 9, Jelly 6, Cruller 4, Sprinkle 2, Plain 1), score += gain and donuts += 1. When n_D >= 2, nobody gains from D.

If void == false and choice == 'Glazed': glazed_picks -= 1 and glazed_used += 1. If void == false and choice == 'Jelly': jelly_picks -= 1 and jelly_used += 1. This applies whether the donut was won or discarded.
Announce each seat's gain this round and every seat's new score and donuts.
End the game if round >= 10, otherwise continue.

ending.decided_by: Highest point total wins. Among players tied on points, the one with the most donuts collected wins. Players still tied share the win, which stands for the source's draw.

rules.text: When the game starts, every player has score 0, donuts 0, glazed_used 0 and jelly_used 0.
When a player answers G (a whole number from 0 to 6) before round 1, then glazed_picks = G and jelly_picks = 6 - G, visible only to that player.
No player other than the owner is ever shown that player's G, glazed_picks or jelly_picks.
When each round begins, round increases by 1, and the round number plus every seat's score, donuts, glazed_used and jelly_used are announced.
When the talk step runs, every player submits one short message simultaneously, and all four messages are shown to everyone only after all are in.
When the choose step runs, every player simultaneously chooses exactly one of Glazed, Jelly, Cruller, Sprinkle or Plain.
When a player chooses Glazed with glazed_picks == 0, or Jelly with jelly_picks == 0, then void = true. Otherwise void = false.
When a choice is void, that player gains 0, uses no pick, and is not counted as choosing that donut.
When choices are revealed, all four choices are shown together, and each void choice is marked VOID.
When exactly one non-void player chooses Glazed, that player gains 9 points and donuts += 1.
When exactly one non-void player chooses Jelly, that player gains 6 points and donuts += 1.
When exactly one non-void player chooses Cruller, that player gains 4 points and donuts += 1.
When exactly one non-void player chooses Sprinkle, that player gains 2 points and donuts += 1.
When exactly one non-void player chooses Plain, that player gains 1 point and donuts += 1.
When two or more non-void players choose the same donut, each of them gains 0 for it and donuts is unchanged.
When a player makes a non-void Glazed choice, glazed_picks decreases by 1 and glazed_used increases by 1, whether the donut was won or discarded.
When a player makes a non-void Jelly choice, jelly_picks decreases by 1 and jelly_used increases by 1, whether the donut was won or discarded.
When a round ends, each seat's gain and new score and donuts totals are announced.
When round 10 has been resolved, the game ends, and unused picks are worth 0.
When the game ends, the highest score wins. A tie on score is broken by the most donuts, and players still tied share the win.

offers.question: Secret split before round 1: how many Glazed picks G?
Choose a donut
offers.options: Glazed, Jelly, Cruller, Sprinkle, Plain, offered in every situation. A Glazed or Jelly choice made with no matching picks left is allowed but void.

choices.why: The designer fixed the table at 4. The five-donut row against four choosers is what creates the collision tension, so another count would change the game.

choices.what: Talk kept as a simultaneous poll broadcast to all
choices.why: The rules specify simultaneous, non-binding messages. Players want different donuts, so claims and bluffs about plans (and hidden pick splits) give real material to reason about.

A thoughtful player infers others' remaining premium picks from the public glazed_used and jelly_used, times Glazed for rounds when others are likely out, and uses talk to bluff or deter. A thoughtless player always grabs Glazed and collides.
Donuts can never exceed 10, so multiplying the score by 100 keeps points primary and donuts as the tie-break.

choices.what: Glazed and Jelly are always offered, even with no picks left
choices.why: The rules define void choices as possible outcomes, so the option must exist.

simplifications.what: A final draw among tied players is represented as a shared win
simplifications.why: The engine has no separate draw: players level at the top share the win, which matches the source's draw among those players.
